verdict.rationale: Statsig documents an official MCP server and a Console API that performs console actions without the web UI. Metrics Explorer offers charting in the UI. However, no evidence shows that dashboards exist as an object, or that an agent can create or populate a dashboard of key metrics through the API or MCP. The generic API and MCP claims do not establish this specific capability.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent build a dashboard of my key metrics end-to-end via the API or MCP server
